text:
Shiki Ichinose doesn't want to be bothered in his room, so watch out.
I need to watch the new season of Tougen Anki.
Don't make Yami wait! Our favorite hero deserves to be treated right.
Starting November in the best way! Stark deserves a little attention, maybe he's thinking about Kraft 🤭

If you're going to introduce Toji Fushiguro, you have to show his feet first.
The foot in the third image looks great 😊
We're saying goodbye to October. Hope you liked all the characters this month, including the story with Goku and Gohan! See you in November 😉
Trick or treat! Venom will make sure you have a happy Halloween.

A lovely night for Hirose and Nakamura!
I'm still trying out a few things.
Admit it, you'd want to be one of Prince Eric's servants! He's one of my favorite princes, who's next?
Now that Bleach has ended, who do you prefer, Grimmjow or Urahara? I already know we all love Ichigo 😉

Goku's Day on Earth is here! Hope you like it.
Goku has arrived on Earth for a day, but Gohan wants to spend as much time with him as possible 😉
